findings.title: Palestinian killed, 5 others wounded in Israel’s ongoing ceasefire violations in Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Three Palestinians reportedly wounded, two seriously, in a separate strike affecting a tent, according to a medical source at Al-Shifa Hospital. Civilian status, displacement status, identities and subsequent outcomes not established. Article revised from two to five injured overall; avoid adding three to aggregate counts from other reporting without reconciliation.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Three more Palestinians were wounded, two of them seriously, when an Israeli drone struck a tent in northern Gaza City
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting attributed to a hospital medical source

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct inspection of Anadolu Middle East index and updated article 4141369; compared against 30 authenticated hourly heartbeats from November 27 00:44 through November 28 05:44.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New separately described northern Gaza City tent incident in revised article; earlier versions logged the Al-Rimal fatality and Khan Younis boy injury, not the three tent injuries.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact update time unavailable; newly discovered within the observation interval, not proven first published within it. No independent corroboration or production collector comparison.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; production remains authoritative.
